# hyperfluid_virtual_machine (Resource)

A virtual machine in an environment, booted from an image of the platform catalog (see `hyperfluid_virtual_machine_images`). Needs the organization's `virtual_machines_enabled` feature.

~> `user_data_secret_name` is read once, at first boot: changing it replaces the virtual machine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_environment" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

data "hyperfluid_virtual_machine_images" "catalog" {
  env = data.hyperfluid_environment.default.id
}

locals {
  ubuntu = one([for i in data.hyperfluid_virtual_machine_images.catalog.images : i if i.image_key == "ubuntu-24.04.qcow2"])
}

# Cloud-init user-data, read once at first boot.
resource "hyperfluid_secret" "cloud_init" {
  name             = "web/cloud-init"
  secret_type      = "plaintext"
  value            = <<-YAML
    #cloud-config
    packages: [nginx]
  YAML
  value_wo_version = "1"
}

resource "hyperfluid_virtual_machine" "web" {
  env                   = data.hyperfluid_environment.default.id
  name                  = "web"
  cpu                   = "2"
  memory                = "4Gi"
  disk                  = "40Gi"
  image_source_ref      = local.ubuntu.image_source_ref
  image_key             = local.ubuntu.image_key
  user_data_secret_name = hyperfluid_secret.cloud_init.name
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = hyperfluid_virtual_machine.web.ip_address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cpu` (String) Whole number of vCPUs, e.g. `"2"`. Changing this forces a new virtual machine.
- `disk` (String) Root disk size, e.g. `"40Gi"`. Changing this forces a new virtual machine.
- `env` (String) Environment id. Changing this forces a new virtual machine.
- `image_key` (String) Image key, from the image catalog. Changing this forces a new virtual machine.
- `image_source_ref` (String) Image source name, from the image catalog. Changing this forces a new virtual machine.
- `memory` (String) Guest memory, e.g. `"4Gi"`. Changing this forces a new virtual machine.
- `name` (String) Name, a DNS label. Changing this forces a new virtual machine.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `install_media_removed` (Boolean) Set to `true` once the guest is installed, to detach the media of an installer image at the next restart. It cannot be set back to `false`.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the virtual machine runs; `false` stops it. Omitted, it starts.
- `tags` (List of String) User-defined tags.
- `user_data_secret_name` (String) Name of an organization-wide plaintext `hyperfluid_secret` holding cloud-init user-data. Changing this forces a new virtual machine.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `install_media` (String) `Attached` or `Removed` for an installer image; null for a disk image.
- `ip_address` (String) Primary IP address of the guest, once it runs.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase, e.g. `Running` or `Stopped`.
- `slug` (String) Derived slug.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Virtual machine import id is the virtual machine id (uuid).
terraform import hyperfluid_virtual_machine.web 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
